case.name: simuhome_qt2_feasible_seed_2
case.query: Ugh, the bathroom air feels almost too crisp, like it is too clean and it makes my nose tingle, I do not love that. And the light in there is pretty dim, I keep squinting and my eyes get tired when I go in.

transcript.text: The plan will run two tasks at once: raise the bathroom humidity and brighten the bathroom light. It will check each device is available; for the humidifier it will set the fan to 70% if already on or turn it on at 70% (manual mode) if it is off. For the dimmable light it will turn it on or set its brightness to 80% so the room is easier to see. Does this plan look good to you?
